description: Search the Klavierstuck catalogue of classical keyboard works, like the site's Works page. Combine free text (title words or a catalogue reference such as "BWV 846" or "Op. 28") with filters given in plain words: composer, key, sub-genre, instrument, performing forces, and a difficulty range on one scale. A name that matches nothing or several entries returns an error listing candidates. Each row has its klavierstuck.org URL and slug (pass it to get_work for details); the answer gives the total count and the sources to cite.

composer.description: Composer in plain words, e.g. "Chopin" or "Clara Schumann".

difficulty_scale.description: Difficulty scale the range applies to in plain words, e.g. "PianoSyllabus" (0–10), "RCM", "ABRSM" or "PianoLibrary".

forces.description: Performing forces in plain words, e.g. "Solo", "Four hands" or "Two pianos".

instrument.description: Instrument in plain words, e.g. "Piano", "Organ" or "Harpsichord".

key.description: Key, in English in plain words, e.g. "D minor", "E-flat major" or "F♯ minor".

limit.description: Works per page: 20 by default, at most 50 (larger values are capped).

query.description: Free text: words of the title or a catalogue reference, e.g. "nocturne" or "Op. 9".

sub_genre.description: Sub-genre, in English in plain words, e.g. "Nocturne", "Waltz" or "Fugue".

name: search_works
title: Search works
